centre.about_html:
UMATTERCARE, located in Toronto, Ontario, offers personalized care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their holistic approach aims to address the mind, body, and spirit, allowing them to effectively treat the root cause of addiction and/or mental health problems. UMATTERCARE offers a wide range of therapies and wellness activities, which can be tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

Some of the services provided by UMATTERCARE include at-home detoxification, on-site medical and non-medical detoxification, individual, couple, and family therapy sessions, life skills training, relapse prevention, art therapy, journaling, dance classes, massage therapy, yoga, outdoor activities, socialization, financial management, weekly shopping trips, and independence and self-control training. 

By providing an individualized approach, UMATTERCARE is able to help individuals on their journey to recovery in a personalized and effective manner.

raw_html:
UMATTERCARE, located in Toronto, Ontario, offers personalized care to individuals struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their holistic approach aims to address the mind, body, and spirit, allowing them to effectively treat the root cause of addiction and/or mental health problems. UMATTERCARE offers a wide range of therapies and wellness activities, which can be tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

Some of the services provided by UMATTERCARE include at-home detoxification, on-site medical and non-medical detoxification, individual, couple, and family therapy sessions, life skills training, relapse prevention, art therapy, journaling, dance classes, massage therapy, yoga, outdoor activities, socialization, financial management, weekly shopping trips, and independence and self-control training. 

By providing an individualized approach, UMATTERCARE is able to help individuals on their journey to recovery in a personalized and effective manner.

UMATTERCARE- Mental Health and Addiction Services - Center Overview

UMATTERCARE provides comprehensive and individualized care to help those struggling with drug use and alcohol abuse achieve optimal mental health and addiction recovery. As a fully licensed Mental Health & Addiction Medical Service provider, they offer evidence-based and trauma-informed care services in the Greater Toronto Area and beyond.

UMATTERCARE’s approach to treatment includes a combination of personalized care, diverse therapies, and wellness activities that cater to the unique needs of each client. By addressing the underlying causes of addiction and prioritizing mental health, UMATTERCARE aims to help individuals on their journey towards healing and recovery.
